rationale: Final three are the first source-feasible, non-SUT-selected queries from two independent local-model passes over the supplier profile: goods, commissioning works, and electrical services. Selection among generated candidates used only raw EIS unique-result counts in the fixed date window, never Tender Agent relevance output.
selection_principles: at least 15 unique public 44-FZ candidates in the frozen date window
mixed goods/works/services semantics rather than near-duplicate synonyms
no candidate relevance labels or Tender Agent scores used in query selection
